title: Deterministic Grow When Required trace
summary: A fixed-input GWR mechanism trace separating adaptation, insertion, resumed growth, and topology cleanup.
learning_objectives: Follow the two-part activity and firing test that chooses adaptation or insertion.
Inspect midpoint node initialization and competitive-Hebbian edge rewiring.
Distinguish paused growth from termination and observe later growth resumption.
See an over-age edge and its isolated node removed from the topology.
limitations: This is a toy mechanism demonstration, not a reproduction of the paper's experiments.
Thresholds, learning rates, habituation factors, edge age, inputs, tie-breaking, and rounding are pinned demo choices rather than universal GWR defaults.
The pedagogical multiplicative habituation policy preserves role ordering but does not reproduce the paper's experimental habituation constants.
The one-dimensional fixed sequence is designed for trace readability, not benchmark evidence or generalization claims.
